# R6.41 — compaction_strategy slot wiring + the HH-native participant (E2-T7 / E2-T8(b))

- **Ticket:** `docs/tickets/302_R6.41__compaction-participant.md` ·
  engineered · **offline, USD $0.00 — no live leg counted**.
- **Deps:** R6.39 (rung record + topology), R6.28 (L1 gate), R6.16
  (scheduling/capture).
- **Requirements:** REQ-XE-122, REQ-XE-121, REQ-XE-126, REQ-XD-102
  primary; REQ-XH-114, REQ-XD-220, REQ-XH-124, REQ-XC-330 contributing.
- **Rung:** the C-05 record `docs/build/reports/r6-39-c05-rung.md`
  reached **rung 1** — the participant path implements and is gated at
  rung 1 only; rung 3 without an admitted AR-04 amendment refuses
  typed (`TopologyError`, X-01 — never relaxed silently).

## What landed

### Stage 1 — `compaction_strategy` slot → `KernelCompaction` (REQ-XE-122, G16a)

- `crates/hh-embed/src/runtime.rs` — `KernelContext.compaction_variants:
  Vec<Rc<dyn CompactionStrategy>>` (the sealed slot's armed ladder;
  `Rc` so the per-drive port clones cheaply; `arm_compaction` per
  bound rung in declared order); `compaction_strategy_for` — the
  **only** mapping variant-ref → first-party C1 strategy
  (`hh/summarize-rolling@1`, `hh/offload-then-summarize@1`,
  `hh/structured-checkpoint@1`, `hh/fresh-window-with-notes@1`,
  `hh/world-state-refresh@1`, `hh/provider-compaction@1`), strict
  member-set decode, `hh/model-owned@1` refused as a code rung
  (β(compact)=model), unknown refs/params typed-refuse — never a
  silent `evict_oldest` substitution; `KernelCompaction::new`
  populates `variants` from the fold (unarmed ⇒ `Vec::new()` —
  byte-identical to the pre-slot construction).
- `crates/hh-embed/src/open.rs` — `compaction_slot` reads the sealed
  `NativeProcess.slots["compaction_strategy"]` (`One`/`Many`,
  OrderedMany); armed at `open_session{new}` **and** re-armed on
  resume from the persisted sealed definition (the arm re-derives,
  never guesses from a durable row). Unresolvable → `Refused`.
- `crates/hh-embed/src/service.rs` — the six C1 variants seeded into
  `seed_registry` under the `compaction_strategy` class (the
  "registered-but-ignored" half: the class was catalogued, no
  first-party variants were published — a slot binding now resolves);
  each carries its `declare()`-truthful
  `{deterministic, op_kinds}` capability declaration.
- **`window_cap` home (AR-22/AR-23 resolution):** the primary
  profile's declared `context_window` → `manifest.extra
  .model_context_window` → `DriverConfig.window_cap_tokens` →
  `AssembleInputs` → `ctx.window_cap` — the existing §5c.1
  `ContextBudget.window_cap` source is kept as the one home (CC1);
  no second channel added.

### Stage 2 — the HH-native participant at rung 1 (E2-T8 (b))

- `crates/hh-runner/src/native.rs` (new) — the runner half:
  `HIR_REQUIRED`/`HIR_OPTIONAL` (REQ-XE-126's exact member set —
  `definition_version_id, semantic_id, profile_hash, bundle_id,
  derivation_key, hh_commit, kernel_binary_sha256,
  representation_ledger_ref, level_assignment,
  override_spellings`; `l1_report_id` optional);
  `check_hir`/`check_participant`; `NativeTopology{rung,
  ar04_amendment_ref?}` — rung 1 admits, rung 2 refuses typed
  (the record's own UNVERIFIED row), rung 3 requires a non-empty
  `ar04_amendment_ref`; `L1GateDecl{pass_id, h_identity,
  canon_version, corpus_digest}`; `l1_gate_match` — recomputes
  `l1_pass_id` over the arm's declared `hir` identity
  (`{bundle_id, definition_version_id, kernel_binary_sha256}`) —
  a changed `definition_version_id` or `kernel_binary_sha256`
  invalidates the match (REQ-XD-102's "any H change requires a
  full L1 rerun"); `native_lane_check` — loopback/pins/token
  check over `cell_env_projection`'s own stamp (one lane home —
  the same pins O's slots receive; the shared semaphore is the
  proxy's one FIFO `Gate`).
- `crates/hh-runner/src/slot_record.rs` — `ExperimentSlot::from_json`
  runs `check_participant` on `participant`: `kind: native` requires
  `hir`; a present `hir` is strictly member-checked (schema check —
  AC-3).
- `crates/hh-runner/src/packet.rs` — `DrivePacket` gains
  `l1_gate{…}` and `native_participants{arm_id → {topology, hir}}`
  (strict decode, absent-not-null — `PartialEq`-complete).
- `crates/hh-runner/src/coordinator.rs` — `slot_packet` stamps
  `participant{kind:native, topology, hir}` for declared native-lane
  arms (fixture `oracle` untouched otherwise — absent-not-null);
  `drive_window` gates every packing unit carrying a `FpArm::
  native_lane()` member on `(l1_gate declared ∧ topology.check() ∧
  l1_gate_match)` — failure withholds the **whole unit**
  `withheld{l1_not_passed}` (pair-atomic, never split; the closed
  disposition set's own spelling).

- `cargo test -p hharness-embed --test r6_41` — **3/3**:
  `ac1_summarize_rolling_fires_under_declared_window_cap` (the bound
  variant's completed record `variant_ref: hh/summarize-rolling@1`,
  `status: applied`, `tokens_freed: 192`, deterministic `Evict`
  fallback under its own name — the `context.compaction.*` rows are
  the port's `CompactionDone.emitted`, which `compact_round` lands
  through the fenced writer unchanged); `ac1_absent_slot_byte_
  identical` (unarmed fold ⇒ `variants.is_empty()`; emitted rows ==

  `hh/evict-oldest@1` answers alone); `ac1_boundary_open_and_
  refusals` (bound slot opens; unregistered variants refuse at seal

## Deviations / honest limits

- `check-removability` extension-section failure pre-existing
  (byte-identical on `origin/main`) — recorded, not caused.
- The `KernelCompaction` port passes `target_fraction_ppm: 0`
  (pre-existing; `to_target = occupancy`) — an explicit-request
  fixture compacts only when the reclaimable set covers the whole
  occupancy; recorded verbatim, never an inferred pass. A hard
  occupancy-triggered compaction that cannot cover it returns
  `CompactionImpossible` → `stop{context_exhausted}` (the exhausted
  ladder — unchanged behavior).
- `input_reduction` is declared-but-untransported (the typed record
  has no JSON codec at this stage) — a declared member refuses
  rather than silently dropping.
